title: Grateful Dead Live at Shrine Auditorium on 1967-11-11
source: Source: 8 Track Master Reel > 1st Gen Reel (7.5ips) > PCM (Sony Beta ESXHiFi/L-750) - Given to Tim Dalton by Bob Menke; Transfer: PCM > Sony SL-10 > Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 > WAV 16/44.1 - Transferred By Charlie Miller; Lineage: wav > Adobe Audition 1.5 > iZotope RX6 Advanced > iZotope 5 Advanced > CD Wave > TLH > Flac 16; edited and mastered SIRMick February 2018

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard recording of a funky, psychedelic Shrine night highlighted by a memorable “Mumblin'” performance.
ai_review.review: The show is praised as an awesome, funk‑laden and psychedelic evening at the Shrine, with the crowd especially noting the “Mumblin’ bitchen’” moment. While the reviewers acknowledge that Charlie Miller and his team worked with limited resources, they still consider the soundboard capture solid enough to enjoy the performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 4‑star review emphasizes a strong musical experience and decent soundboard quality, leading to an overall good rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes the engineers did the best they could with what they had, implying a competent but not pristine recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Funky and psychedelic vibe throughout; the night is described as an awesome, energetic performance at the Shrine.
